entries.test: Anthropic's spending and cash-burn records for the reported period would show whether any interval exhibited cost reductions or declining monthly burn.

entries.test: Anthropic's revenue, usage, and service-delivery spending over the reported period would show whether costs rose as its business grew.

entries.note: 'I don't think people would pay' expresses a negative expectation under a prospective price increase.
'Empty tropes' and 'far more mediocre' are judgments of worth.
